subject: Re: Pickup quote 22911 Hamburg North to HAM on 2026-11-27
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for reaching out! We can pick up your freight in Hamburg North on your requested date and deliver it to the air export warehouse at HAM. Our all-in price is 221.05 EUR, and the pickup time is 17 hours.

The quote is valid until 22 Nov 2026 00:28 UTC. Your offer reference is TRK-8731, and there’s no need to book the pickup.

Best regards,
Nordlicht Haulage
